sentences.text: The documents do not state a settlement period for a locker-related insurance claim; they state that a UCB would not be under any liability to insure the contents of the locker against any risk whatsoever.

For a safe deposit locker / articles in safe custody claim, a UCB shall, within 15 calendar days of receipt of all the required documents, process the claim and communicate with the claimant(s) for fixing the date for making inventory of the locker / articles in safe custody.
